title.value: Match receipts to bank transactions in accounting software

introduction.value: A small consultancy had Operator match 42 digital receipts to bank transactions and flag discrepancies, getting 85% right and struggling with a blurry handwritten scan.

method.value: SquidCircle gave Operator a dedicated browser environment and a folder of digital receipts covering a month of business expenses. The agent logged into their accounting software, matched 42 receipts to bank transactions, and flagged discrepancies. It picked out vendor names, amounts and tax categories.

outcome.value: About 85% of entries were handled perfectly, saving roughly 4 hours of manual entry in one afternoon. It struggled with one blurry handwritten scan.

notes.value: The authors advise using a sandboxed browser profile, limited viewer or contributor roles, and a human click before any money moves. Operator is a paid beta for Plus, Team and Enterprise users.

source_text.body:
Match receipts to bank transactions in accounting software
A small consultancy had Operator match 42 digital receipts to bank transactions and flag discrepancies, getting 85% right and struggling with a blurry handwritten scan.
Done with
OP
Operator
What they did
SquidCircle gave Operator a dedicated browser environment and a folder of digital receipts covering a month of business expenses. The agent logged into their accounting software, matched 42 receipts to bank transactions, and flagged discrepancies. It picked out vendor names, amounts and tax categories.
How it went
About 85% of entries were handled perfectly, saving roughly 4 hours of manual entry in one afternoon. It struggled with one blurry handwritten scan.
Worth knowing
The authors advise using a sandboxed browser profile, limited viewer or contributor roles, and a human click before any money moves. Operator is a paid beta for Plus, Team and Enterprise users.
Try it yourself
with
Operator
Copy prompt
In the folder [path to receipts folder] I have [number] digital receipts, and in [bank export file, e.g. a CSV] I have my bank transactions for [date range]. Match each receipt to a transaction by amount, date and vendor, and produce a spreadsheet listing every match, plus a separate list of discrepancies, unreadable receipts and unmatched items with your reasoning. Finish when every receipt is accounted for, and mark low-confidence matches clearly for me to review. Do not change any of my original files.
Original source: https://blog.squidcircle.com/openai-operator-beta-smb-expense-automation/
